scope: Computational artificial-life research: integer programs on a bounded virtual machine, search operators and simulated populations of software objects. No biological material, organism, procedure or design of any kind.
idle: half the episodes get one empty tick at a random position (before ask / between PUTs / before first PUT)
ruler: L1 distance between 7-vectors (NaN components skipped); nearest-centroid assignment

reading_rules.TRAVELS: after transplant, >= 2/3 of tops stay nearest the ORIGIN arm's centroid
reading_rules.RECONSTRUCTED: >= 2/3 nearest the HOST world's plain-arm centroid

material_rule: idle vs plain centroids differ by >= .10 L1 in either world, OR the transplant reading is TRAVELS or RECONSTRUCTED
continuation: single-program neutral walk in the host world
